# Fire Safety Installation ITP (Inspection and Test Plan)

25 checkpoints across 6 sections.Prepared at project kick-off for fire safety systems; used throughout installation phase to guide QC inspections and test activities

Download ExcelDownload PDF

Prepared once at start; updated only if major scope changes occur
